ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Pyrinth
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Absorbed copy of det.epochspyrinth ("Epochs - Pyrinth"): the glowing orange pyrinth ore, its torch/wall-torch/pylon/heater furniture family, the pyrinth blade melee weapon, and its sparking mote effects (CRYSTAL_INGEST_EXECUTION_1 item 1, design/Jawa/mods/crystal_mods_inventory.md). Generic content, no Star Wars or campaign material === RimMandrake tier per design/NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md.
NOT YET DEPLOYABLE: det.epochspyrinth is still active in the live mod list and this pack preserves its defNames verbatim, so loading both together collides. This mod stays dormant in the repo until a future retirement item removes det.epochspyrinth from the mod list. The Lantern-Deeps natural-scatter gate (CRYSTAL_INGEST_EXECUTION_1's actual live-effect deliverable) patches the LIVE donor def directly instead === see src/RimUtinni/LanternDeeps/Patches/RUT_LanternDeepGatePyrinth.xml.
